findings.title: No CloudTrail trails enabled and logging were found.
findings.description:
Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions.

Risk: AWS CloudTrail records API activity; without it incidents cannot be investigated.

findings.title: Security group example-bastion (sg-0123456789abcdef0) has SSH port 22 open to the Internet.
findings.description:
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to SSH port 22.

Risk: If Security groups are not properly configured the attack surface is increased.
findings.remediation:
Apply Zero Trust approach. Implement a process to scan and remediate unrestricted or overly permissive security groups.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_SecurityGroups.html

CLI: aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0123456789abcdef0 --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
